local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=0;local staged=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt
 assert(self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x85e4f),'Cold flame check lost original Dark Salvation cell')
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died in cold flame check')
 if elapsed<2 then return end
 -- Camera only: do not move Player, touch corpse locals or reissue PMS.
 camera.setMode(camera.MODE.Static)
 camera.setStaticPosition(util.vector3(-350,100,2345))
 camera.setYaw(math.pi/2);camera.setPitch(0)
 if not staged then
  staged=true
  print('FlamingCorpse static-camera diagnostic; Player retains earned entrance position '..tostring(self.position))
 end
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if obj.id=='0x1098138' then
   assert(not types.Actor.isDead(obj),'Ilend died in cold flame check')
   if elapsed>=6 then print('FlamingCorpse cold source ready') end
  end
 end
end}}}}
